mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (user_id, course_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, 1) ON CONFLICT (user_id, course_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 1, enrolled_at = now(), canceled_at = NULL WHERE enrollment.status = 2
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollment SET status = 2, canceled_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM enrollment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 )

SELECT e.id, e.course_id, c.title AS course_title, e.status, e.enrolled_at, e.canceled_at, c.status AS course_status, c.enroll_end FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.enrolled_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
SELECT user_id FROM enrollment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
